comments.author: tribes33
comments.body:
Sorry for the bare title, I accidentally pressed post

It's a Co-op 3 Player Roguelite that consists of a MMO party-like system of a Tank, DPS and a Healer

Obviously very bare, it's just basic Godot with Blender MCP, using GLM 5.3 Flash for the models

The games actually all 3D, with models turned into sprites, AI is pretty ass with 2D spritework, but if you use a lowpoly 3D Model you can get a good result when you basically turn down the resolution and animation framerate, and make the model snap in 22.5 degrees for each angle

replies.author: beneficialdiet18
replies.body: What did you use for animations and how did you make the models? Was it by using GLM with Blender MCP?

replies.author: tribes33
replies.body: Basically each animation is a different pose in Blender then baked into a spritesheet, but I don't think this will work for what Im trying to do, cause I cant make characters equip different pieces of gear and such

replies.author: beneficialdiet18
replies.body: Would love if you can go into more detail for the entire process! Wishing you success.

comments.author: thetinytrex
comments.body: This looks pretty sick. I keep wanting to start new projects because of how fast the capabilities of the newest models develop. Having more fun building games than playing games these days.
